title: putting this on your radar: chinese republicans at @Roundabout Theatr...
transcript: Chinese republicans is the kind of play that immediately sparks conversation. It's now playing off broadway at roundabout's laurence olivier theater. I went to see chinese republicans on roundabout's community night. It's a really cool pre show initiative they do where the audience can gather and chat and connect over food and drinks. This one was in celebration of the A A N H P I. Community. It was incredible food, beautiful flowers, just a really great way to engage with other theater people. Then it was showtime. The play follows three women who work at a large investment firm. They're all chinese or chinese american, and they meet monthly to compare career victories. That is until twenty four year old new hire katie joins their circle. She's trying to learn how to survive a career in finance, but ends up learning what it actually takes to climb the corporate ladder. It's a story about ambition and identity and the pressure to fit into systems that weren't built for you. It's exactly the big idea conversations that off broadway makes room for. And it's running until april fifth at roundabout theatre. Go check it out!
